Implemented restart agents with current config feature:

- Backend API endpoints (GET/POST /api/agents/restart-with-current-config) to list agents with staffing changes and perform selective restart
- Frontend button (Zap icon) in header status bar to launch restart modal
- Modal dialog showing all eligible agents with current vs new model/harness, supporting selective restart via checkboxes
- Respects paused/troubled agent gates (skips them in the list)
- Uses existing lifecycle restart flow for graceful stop + fresh spawn with new config
- Skips conversations (work agents only)
- Preserves work context (workspace, beads, continue state) on restart

All AC requirements met. Tests passing.
